roles.speaker: May be a fluent/native Russian volunteer, who chooses freely and records exact utterances. Does not approve text/audio RU03.
roles.expertReviewer: Must be a separately appointed qualified Russian-as-foreign-language (РКИ) / phonetics reviewer, with identity, competency and independence verified by human governance. No automated appointment.
roles.rightsVerifier: Independently validates licensing, identity/authority of recording rights grant and archive conditions; a speaker checkbox is not proof.
roles.coordinator: Only a trusted human sends the optional invitation, collects consent privately and handles three-file package.

September 2026 community and Mozilla discussion reports some Russian dataset recordings were synthesized and not welcome; no automatic authenticity proof.
